text:
andrea: Quick sync — we need to lock priorities for the post-launch iteration. Customers reported a latency regression and one integration edge-case; we also have 3 feature asks from sales. Propose we decide what must go into the hotfix vs backlog for the next sprint.
liam: +1. Can we run a quick triage matrix? impact vs effort.
sophia: I ran perf traces — latency spike looks related to KV cache eviction on long chats. I can put a small fix that pins common prefixes, estimate 1-2 dev days.
dmitri: Ops saw increased retries during rollouts, likely tied to the same cache churn. This is customer-facing and causing error spikes for a few enterprise tenants.
maya: From design/user impact, the integration edge-case causes confusing UI state but not data loss. Sales is pushing for the reporting enhancement though.
andrea: Proposed rubric:
```
- P0 (hotfix): data loss, >5% revenue impact, or SLA-breaching errors
- P1 (fast follow): high customer impact but bounded effort (<=3 dev days)
- Enhancement: new capability or >3 dev days
```
liam: That rubric seems sane. Using it: latency KV fix => P1 (bounded effort but customer impact). Integration UI => Enhancement (UX work, low error). Reporting feature => Enhancement unless enterprise deal needs it now.
sophia: Agree. If we do the KV pinning as a P1 we can include a canary rollout and toggle. I can prep a small migration and feature flag.
andrea: Timeline suggestion:
- Patch window (48–72h): hotfix only (nothing new)
- Sprint+1: KV fix + canary + monitoring alerts (P1)
- Sprint+2: Reporting & UI polish (Enhancements)
dmitri: I'll add automated alerting to detect cache churn and a rollback playbook. Also recommend a short dogfood in staging with high token-length chats.
maya: I'll draft the UX changes and a quick acceptance checklist for the integration case.
liam: Estimates: KV pinning 2d, canary infra 1d, alerts 0.5d, UX 3d, reporting 5d. We can slice reporting for a 2-week MVP.
andrea: Decision: follow rubric — no new enhancements in the emergency patch window. Move KV fix to sprint+1 as P1, schedule reporting slices for sprint+2. Assign owners and follow-up tickets. @liam can you create the tickets and tag owners? :thumbsup:
liam: Yep - creating tickets now. I'll include deployment playbook and rollback steps.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging: build/2026.02.03.117 — canary flags enabled.
andrea: Thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap doc and send a recap to sales and CS with the new timelines. If anything urgent changes, ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
